advancedthaumaturgy.original_wip: This device was unfinished in AT2-30r; it has no working behavior.
advancedthaumaturgy.structure_wip: Original multiblock prototype formed. AT2-30r provides no machine behavior or survival recipe.
advancedthaumaturgy.node.ready: Place a jarred node above. Hover for costs.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.MERCURIALRO: Implementation notes: A costly infusion combines a nether star, quicksilver and silverwood cores.
Implementation notes: Capacity follows the largest registered wand rod, with a minimum of 500 and maximum of 1000 vis per primal aspect.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.MERCURIALWA: Implementation notes: A capacious wand accepting crystal upgrades.
Implementation notes: Assembly accepts registered wand caps. Its base cost per primal is 10 plus the cap crafting cost.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.ARCANECRYST: Implementation notes: Smelt infused endstone into a crystal suitable for further infusion.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.NODEMODIFIE: Implementation notes: Place a jarred node above the device, jars nearby and essences on pedestals.

Implementation notes: Processing first draws one essentia each second, then one essence each ten seconds. Adding an aspect requires four matching essences; at most six aspects. Increasing capacity affects the first aspect. Replacing the target cancels work without refunding spent reagents.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.ETHEREALJAR: Implementation notes: A reinforced jar with four times the storage.
Implementation notes: The AT2-30r implementation scans a 17 by 17 area at the device height. Keep crops or farmland at that height. Nearby jars supply Aqua and Herba, stored up to 64 each. Growth consumes half a Herba; hydration does not spend Aqua in the original implementation.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.ESSENTIAENG: Implementation notes: Converts fuel essentia to Forge Energy. Default buffer 32000 FE, output 80 FE/t; each fuel value yields 1000 FE. Ignis/Ordo: 4, other primals: 2, Arbor/Herba/Metallum: 1, Potentia: 8. A redstone signal enables active upward output. Fuel input defaults to pipes, with nearby-jar mode available in server config.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.UPGRADERECH: Implementation notes: Restores one random primal vis every 30 ticks, up to about 15% capacity. The multiplier also affects this recharge. Apply by infusion, or at a wandbench for 42 base vis per primal. Reapplying the same upgrade is rejected.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.UPGRADEDRAI: Implementation notes: Each accepted primal vis produces two vis without doubling the amount removed from the source. Apply by infusion, or at a wandbench for 42 base vis per primal. Reapplying the same upgrade is rejected.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.UPGRADECOMP: Implementation notes: Drains compound node aspects and recursively splits them into primals, only when every component fits. Apply by infusion, or at a wandbench for 42 base vis per primal. Reapplying the same upgrade is rejected.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.UPGRADEDISC: Implementation notes: Subtracts 0.1 from the wand vis consumption multiplier. Apply by infusion, or at a wandbench for 42 base vis per primal. Reapplying the same upgrade is rejected.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.UPGRADESTAB: Implementation notes: Starting infusion with this wand caps instability at 75% of its initial value. This restores the original WIP intention using the host API. Apply by infusion, or at a wandbench for 42 base vis per primal. Reapplying the same upgrade is rejected.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.UPGRADEPOTE: Implementation notes: Adds two potency levels to focus effects, stacking with existing focus upgrades. Apply by infusion, or at a wandbench for 42 base vis per primal. Reapplying the same upgrade is rejected.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.MINILITHBAS: Implementation notes: Purified totems form a base for specialized crystals.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.MINILITHFLU: Implementation notes: Converts nearby flux goo to gas, then removes gas with a chance to recover Vitium. Extract recovered essentia using pipes or phials.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.MINILITHWAT: Implementation notes: Right-click empty-handed to keep its own chunk ticking. Deactivation or removal releases the ticket. AT2-30r code loads one chunk, despite older text claiming nine.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.MINILITHHEA: Implementation notes: When active, heals an injured nearby player by one health every 41 ticks, consuming one Sano. Range five blocks.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.MINILITHZAP: Implementation notes: AT2-30r supplies a recipe and research but no working sentry. Retained as an original unfinished item; it does not attack.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.MINILITHFIR: Implementation notes: When active, spends one Ignis for ten fireballs. A hit deals five damage and burns the target for five seconds. Fireballs do not ignite terrain.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.MINILITHFRO: Implementation notes: AT2-30r supplies a recipe and research but no working sentry. Retained as an original unfinished item; it does not attack.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.VOIDCAGE.0: Implementation notes: Original creative-only focus with no survival recipe. Captures a living creature in sight for 50 Ordo and 50 Perditio vis; use on a block to release. Players, passengers and occupied mounts cannot be captured. Blocked or failed release keeps the creature in the focus. AT2-30r has no implemented long-term corruption timer; creatures do not decay while stored.
advancedthaumaturgy.research.WANDBENCH.0: Implementation notes: AT2-30r provides no survival recipe. Left: target wand. Middle: crystal, rod, two matching caps. Right: paying wand. Output appears only when affordable. Existing name, focus, upgrades and vis are preserved; a smaller rod clamps excess vis. Breaking the bench drops physical inputs only.
